restrictions: Separate measured, configured and reserved resources.
Observations do not initialize, reconcile, repair or reap SDK state.
Observation never grants machine ownership.
Remote preparation is retained-machine only.
OCI requires explicit approved guest networking.
Preparation content digest differs from registry platform-manifest digest.
Full native receipt and authorized material evolution required.
Unknown outcomes retain reservations; deletion requires authority.
UTF-8 stdin at most 64 KiB; buffered foreground only.
Background is retained-image launch evidence, not observed Exit.
Streaming rejects stdin and background; native bare guest rejects explicit user.
Approved guest roots, bounded reads and atomic bounded writes.
Cancellation is not rollback or proof of guest absence.
Managed pull requires OCI-created machine and separately approved source.
Imported packed metadata does not prove a download.
Boot/agent console diagnostics, not application stdout or readiness.
Bounded tail/follow with no implicit start or reconnect.
Managed retained image only; no disposable/checkpoint sessions.
Single consumer, finite input/output/session budgets, no reattach or replay.
Canonical exclusive approved root, independent disk reservation.
Exclusive attachments including read-only; unknown deletion retains capacity.
Created/stopped, growth only, absolute targets 1-64 GiB.
No checkpoint/branch sources or children; no implicit stop/start.
macOS HTTP growth has no qualification campaign.
Idle offline bare guest, no ports/workload/external packed dependencies.
Capture preserves running source; restore acquires independent owned identity.
Stopped source and approved registry destination.
Container workspace, host mounts and RAM excluded.
Implicit flattening VM must not bypass epoch guard or auxiliary accounting.
Offline idle same-worker source; one leaf, no networking/ports/workload.
Explicit held release, source dependencies and additional backing allowance.
Native only; HTTP intentionally does not advertise these operations.
Creation absence remains read-only and requires owned quiescence/material proof.
